title: Somatic evolution in abdominal aortic aneurysms
summary:
Identification and characterization of somatic mutations in abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA).

In tissue samples of AAA patients aquired genetic alterations might be found within the aneurysm vascular wall that could explain disease development and progression.

Blood samples and tissue samples of AAA patients are investigated and analyzed by whole-exome sequencing and microarray techniques.
conditions: Abdominal aortic aneurysm, without mention of rupture

interventions.name:
Whole-genome sequencing of blood and aortic aneurysm specimen.
Prospective study, analyses at the time of surgical abdominal aortic aneurysm repair
